data.name: Cobby
data.long_meaning: In ancient Greece, the name Cob was given to those who were skilled in crafting horseshoes. The diminutive form, Cobby, was used as a term of endearment for those who possessed this valuable skill. In Christian tradition, the name Cobby may also symbolize strength and protection, as a horseshoe shields a horse's hooves from harm.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of strength, protection, and craftsmanship
